# World History Encyclopedia

> > A comprehensive digital encyclopedia covering ancient civilizations, classical antiquity, and world history from Mesopotamia and Egypt to Greece, Rome, and beyond.

World History Encyclopedia provides detailed articles, timelines, maps, and images documenting ancient cultures including Sumer, the Achaemenid Persian Empire, Athens, Rome, and the Hellenistic world. The site features scholarly content on historical figures like Homer and Thucydides, ancient warfare, religious practices, and archaeological sites.

## Key Topics

- Ancient Greece and Athens
- Roman Empire and Classical Rome
- Mesopotamia and Sumer
- Ancient Egypt
- Achaemenid Persian Empire
- Hellenistic Period
- Bronze Age civilizations
- Ancient warfare and military history
- Elam and Bactria
- Historical timelines
- Ancient Anatolia and Phrygia
- Classical philosophy and Stoicism
- Archaeological sites and maps
- Byzantine Empire
- Ancient mythology and religion

## Major Civilizations and Periods

- [Knossos - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/knossos): Minoan palace on Crete, home of King Minos and Theseus-Minotaur myth
- [Hellenistic Period - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/Hellenistic_Period): Overview of Hellenistic Period following Alexander's conquests
- [Greco-Bactrian Kingdom - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/Greco-Bactria): Greco-Macedonian dynasties ruling Bactria 250-130 BCE under Diodotos
- [Lutetia - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/Lutetia): Ancient Gaul capital of Parisii tribe, origins of Paris

## Ancient Warfare and Military History

- [Warfare - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/warfare): Ancient warfare from Sumer and Mesopotamia to Warring States period
- [Map of the Battle of Gaugamela - Setup - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/image/150/map-of-the-battle-of-gaugamela---setup): Battle map of Alexander the Great vs Achaemenid Persian Empire
- [Assyrian Lion Hunt Relief - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/image/96/assyrian-lion-hunt-relief): Neo-Assyrian frieze from Ashurbanipal's palace at Nineveh (668-631 BCE)

## Philosophy, Religion, and Mythology

- [Zeno of Citium - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/Zeno_of_Citium): Founder of Stoic philosophy in Athens (c. 336-265 BCE)
- [The Mesopotamian Pantheon - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/article/221/the-mesopotamian-pantheon): Sumerian and Babylonian gods including Marduk in ancient Mesopotamia
- [Hygieia, the Goddess of Health - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/article/253/hygieia-the-goddess-of-health): Greek goddess Hygieia and ancient medicine healing cult with Asklepios
- [Kykeon - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/Kykeon): Ancient Greek barley beverage used in Eleusinian Mysteries ritual

## Historical Figures and Historians

- [Thucydides - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/Thucydides): Athenian historian of Peloponnesian War between Athens and Sparta
- [Flavius Anastasius Probus - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/image/569/flavius-anastasius-probus): Byzantine consul (517 CE) in consular garb holding sceptre and mappa

## Historical Timelines

- [Timeline: Writing](https://www.worldhistory.org/timeline/writing): Chronological timeline of writing development from Sumerian cuneiform
- [Timeline: Coinage](https://www.worldhistory.org/timeline/coinage): Chronological timeline of ancient currency from Lydians to Roman coins
- [Timeline: Ugarit](https://www.worldhistory.org/timeline/ugarit): Bronze Age timeline of Ugarit sea port in Northern Levant
- [Timeline: Trapezus](https://www.worldhistory.org/timeline/Trapezus): Timeline of ancient Greek Black Sea city Trapezus (Trebizond/Trabzon)

## Historical Maps and Geography

- [Elam Map - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/image/142/elam-map): Bronze Age map of Elamite Empire and Persian Gulf region
- [Map of Gordium - World History Encyclopedia](https://www.worldhistory.org/image/251/map-of-gordium): Map showing Phrygian city of Gordium layout

## Optional

- [Timeline: Eshmunazor II](https://www.worldhistory.org/timeline/Eshmunazor_II): Timeline of Phoenician ruler Eshmunazor II
